Comparison anchor ('leading silicon-doped commercially available battery tested by 12%') is unnamed. Independent-lab attestation is asserted but the lab is not identified. This is a disclosure-quality issue for what is the central technology marketing number, so MODERATE per Heuristic 9. Not SEVERE because conditions aren't actively contradicted elsewhere and the patent base supports the underlying architecture story.

moderate_claims.claim_text: Cell architecture designed to enable silicon anodes to achieve >=1,000 cycles to 80% remaining capacity.

However, the simultaneous mix is unusual: convertible debt at 4.75% (2030 issuance), ATM open, buyback executed near 52-week-low prices (avg $10.74), warrant dividend issued AND early-expired within 6 weeks — these are classic stock-price-management mechanics. Repeated capital-structure churn (Affiliate Notes from Chairman, warrant dividend tied to 30-day VWAP $10.50 condition) is a yellow-flag for managing optics of a stalled commercial ramp. Cumulative deficit ~$978M against effectively pre-revenue commercial ramp (performance obligations only $5.3M) signals burn vs commercial-traction gap. MODERATE.
